card.name: Punctuation inside numbers and listings
card.fires_on: Single punctuation marks or digits at a joint in structured text, such as the comma in a device string, the decimal point inside a percentage, or the opening parenthesis after a command name in a man-page list.

modes.label: Inside percentages
modes.description: A decimal point or leading digit within a percent figure for patients with an adverse event.

modes.label: Command listings
modes.description: The opening parenthesis after a command name before its manual section number.

modes.label: Device strings
modes.description: A comma inside a hardware description line in terminal output.

card.plain: It fires on small punctuation marks and digits inside numbers and technical listings, not on any medical meaning.
